outcome: Proportion of eligible mothers not receiving antenatal magnesium sulphate
cohort: Women who gave birth between 23(+0) and 29(+6) weeks' gestation from 2010 to mid-2013 at the Women's and Children's Hospital in Adelaide, South Australia
finding: There was a reduction in the proportion of eligible mothers not receiving antenatal magnesium sulphate from 2010 to 2013, with non-receipt in 2012-2013 predominantly associated with imminent or emergent birth.
